text:
Nora: Quick capture from onboarding w/ Meridian today — two asks that are on their renewal checklist (renewal ~5w): (1) a single "one-download" report showing route-level spend breakdown (tokens, $ by billing tier) they can hand to finance; (2) a way to silence non-actionable alerts during their core hours and a scheduled digest email instead.
Ben: Got it. Do we have a verbatim quote for the finance ask?
Nora: Quote: 'Our CFO just needs a CSV we can plug into our ledger. Screenshots and dashboards won't fly.' They also said: 'Alerts are noise; we want a daily digest not pings.'
Aria: Flagging as potential renewal risk if unaddressed. Both items are product + telemetry work.
Devish: Dev quick take: if we already compute route aggregates we can add a CSV endpoint + UI download in ~8-10 dev days. Dollar columns require joining with pricing tiers and validating discounts per org 1-3w extra. Scheduled digest + mute windows (org-level) looks small ~3-5 dev days.
Cait: Can we offer a manual stopgap? CS can run the export weekly and email the CFO while product builds full export. Meridian is OK with temporary help if we own it for 4-6 weeks.
Nora: They can also provide their preferred CSV column order; they uploaded an example to the shared folder. They volunteered to beta the final export.
Ben: Action items: 1) Devish to confirm whether pricing join exists in telemetry within 48h and give firm ETA for interim vs full; 2) Nora to attach Meridian's CSV example and confirm beta; 3) Cait to create productboard ticket and mark renewal-impact. Check-in 72h.
Devish: I'll spike the pricing join tomorrow and post blockers. If pricing join absent, interim CSV w/o $ is ship-in-1w, full with $ in 3-4w.
product-bot: Created PB-9003 "Meridian: route spend export + alert digest" tags=[cs, renewal-risk].
Cait: I'll add renewal note and AM escalation to PB-9003. Also mention manual CS export as stopgap.
Aria: I'll add this to the weekly renewal sweep and notify the account lead.
Nora: Keeping it hot. Will DM if Meridian asks to escalate. :thumbsup:
